hero.alt: Automation and control on a Figlmueller production platform
hero.title: Automation & Control

title: Intelligent operation
for reliable production
intro.body: Integrated automation and control, built into every machine. One interface. Full production cycle. Less manual intervention, more consistent output.

blocks.title: PLC-Based Control
blocks.body: The PLC runs the sequence: weighing, transfer, water addition, mixing, discharge, monitoring. Controlled. Repeatable. Every cycle.

blocks.title: HMI Touchscreen
blocks.body: Monitor status. Enter parameters. Adjust settings. Select mix designs. One centralized control point.

blocks.title: Mix Design Management
blocks.body: Multiple mix designs, stored and ready. Fast adaptation to project requirements. Controlled proportions, every time.

blocks.title: Alarm & Protection
blocks.body: Detects abnormal conditions. Alerts the operator. Better safety. Protected equipment. Less downtime.
